description: This bar chart illustrates the performance gain for three large vision-language models—GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen-72B-VL—under conditions of strong and weak supervision. The horizontal axis displays the model names in the order GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen-72B-VL, representing the categories being compared. The vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (%)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. For each model, there are two bars representing performance gain under different supervision levels: “Strong Supervision” is represented by a dark blue bar, and “Weak Supervision” is represented by a light purple bar. For GPT-4o, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 24, while the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 12. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 10, and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 8. For Qwen-72B-VL, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 12, and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 6. The bars are arranged in pairs, one for each supervision level, adjacent to each model name. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not indicate any specific sorting order beyond the listed model names.
